## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 2-fascicle text by [支謙](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%94%AF%E8%AC%99) Zhī Qiān is the second early Chinese version of the *Sukhāvatī-vyūha-sūtra*, after [Lokakṣema's T0361](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0061) but before [the canonical T0360](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0060). The unusually long, transcription-heavy title preserves much of the Sanskrit original phonologically and is characteristic of the early-Three-Kingdoms transcription style.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to [支謙](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%94%AF%E8%AC%99) Zhī Qiān's Wú-period activity (222 – 253 CE).

The Taishō text (T0362) is established on the standard apparatus.
